identityPolicy: Exact existing stellar component identifiers and ATNF PSRJ names. No coordinate matching. Some recently catalogued pulsars have no SIMBAD record; use their frozen ATNF identifiers. Nebula aliases resolving to illuminating stars or galaxy clusters are withheld. Gaia compact-object aliases identify the plotted unresolved system.

extensions.note: Second extended.adql query appended for nebula batch 1 of the 2000-ly census; earlier rows are unchanged.
Third extended.adql query appended for nebula batch 2; vdB numbers are omitted because SIMBAD attaches them to the illuminating stars. Earlier rows are unchanged.
Fourth extended.adql query appended for nebula batch 3; vdB, vdBH, DG 174 and LBN 472 identifiers are omitted because SIMBAD attaches them to the illuminating stars. Earlier rows are unchanged.

Five extended.adql queries appended for the 607 dark nebulae within 1000 ly (LDN, Barnard, FeSt 1 and Sandqvist identifiers). LDN 1535 resolves to the protostar IRAS 04325+2402, so only cloud records identify dark nebulae. A sixth query adds Sh 2-276 (Barnard’s Loop). Earlier rows are unchanged.
A query appended for the Galactic Center: Sagittarius A*, S2 and GCIRS 7. S29, S38, S55 and S4716 have no SIMBAD record under these names. Earlier rows are unchanged.

A query appended for the landmark remnants and compact objects: IC 443 and Sh 2-240 (Simeis 147), SS 433, GRS 1915+105, the magnetars SGR 1806-20 and SGR 1900+14 under their ATNF names, CXOU J061705.3+222127, PSR J0205+6449 and PSR B1853+01. Earlier rows are unchanged.
A query appended for the open clusters Cl Melotte 22 (Pleiades) and Cl Melotte 25 (Hyades). Earlier rows are unchanged.

A query appended for the extreme giants, massive stars and Wolf–Rayet binaries of the Notable distant stars catalog: VY CMa, UY Sct, Stephenson 2 DFK 1, WOH G 64, the Pistol Star, RMC 136a1, Westerlund 1 W 26, WR 140 and WR 104. The SIMBAD records of WR 140 and WR 104 are the unresolved systems and identify their Wolf–Rayet components A. Earlier rows are unchanged.

A query appended for the globular clusters NGC 104, NGC 5139, M 4, M 13, M 22, M 15 and Cl Terzan 5 and the H II regions W 49a, W 51, Cygnus X, RCW 49 (GUM 29), IC 1805, IC 1848 and Sh 2-106. Earlier rows are unchanged.

A query appended for spec-card identities of the open clusters M 44, NGC 869, NGC 884, M 67 and NGC 3532, the far nebulae and remnants M 8, M 16, M 17, M 20, the Rosette, Carina, North America and Tarantula nebulae, Puppis A, W 44, W 50, 3C 58 and G1.9+0.3, the hypervelocity stars HE 2251-5127 (S5-HVS1) and US 708, and PSR J1748-2446ad. Earlier rows are unchanged.
